mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RECALL_LOG (LOG_ID, USER_ID, KEYWORD_ID, ROOM_ID, ASK_MESSAGE_ID, RESULT) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{keywordId}, #{roomId}, #{askMessageId}, 'ASKED')
mapper.sql: L.LOG_ID AS ID, L.USER_ID, L.KEYWORD_ID, L.ROOM_ID, L.ASK_MESSAGE_ID, L.ANSWER_MESSAGE_ID, L.RESULT, CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(L.ASKED_AT) * 1000 AS SIGNED) AS ASKED_AT, CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(L.CHECKED_AT) * 1000 AS SIGNED) AS CHECKED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM RECALL_LOG L WHERE L.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND L.RESULT = 'ASKED' AND L.ASKED_AT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{ttlMinutes} MINUTE) ORDER BY L.ASKED_AT DESC, L.LOG_ID DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE RECALL_LOG SET RESULT = #{result}, ANSWER_MESSAGE_ID = #{answerMessageId}, CHECKED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE LOG_ID = #{logId} AND RESULT = 'ASKED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECALL_LOG L WHERE L.USER_ID = #{userId} AND L.ASKED_AT >= CURDATE() AND L.ASKED_AT < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
mapper.sql: FROM RECALL_LOG L WHERE L.USER_ID = #{userId} AND L.RESULT <> 'ASKED' AND L.ASKED_AT >= CONCAT(#{from}, ' 00:00:00') AND L.ASKED_AT <= CONCAT(#{to}, ' 23:59:59.999')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ASKED, COALESCE(SUM(L.RESULT = 'HIT'), 0) AS HIT, COALESCE(SUM(L.RESULT = 'MISS'), 0) AS MISS, COALESCE(SUM(L.RESULT = 'UNCLEAR'), 0) AS UNCLEAR

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(L.ASKED_AT, '%Y-%m-01')
DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(L.ASKED_AT, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(L.ASKED_AT) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')
DATE_FORMAT(L.ASKED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `DATE`, COUNT(*) AS ASKED, COALESCE(SUM(L.RESULT = 'HIT'), 0) AS HIT, COALESCE(SUM(L.RESULT = 'MISS'), 0) AS MISS FROM RECALL_LOG L WHERE L.USER_ID = #{q.userId} AND L.RESULT <> 'ASKED' AND L.ASKED_AT >= CONCAT(#{q.from}, ' 00:00:00') AND L.ASKED_AT <= CONCAT(#{q.to}, ' 23:59:59.999') GROUP BY `DATE` ORDER BY `DATE`
